acceptance_criteria: EngineeringResult.from_mapping handles a legacy mapping with no developer_attempts_remaining key: yields None
EngineeringResult.from_mapping handles a mapping where developer_attempts_remaining is an explicit integer 0: yields 0, distinguishable from the legacy/unknown case
EngineeringResult.from_mapping handles a mapping where developer_attempts_remaining is a positive integer: yields that integer unchanged
EngineeringResult.from_mapping handles a mapping where developer_attempts_remaining is JSON null (a persisted None round-tripping through to_dict): yields None without raising
for every one of the four cases above, EngineeringResult(...).to_dict() followed by EngineeringResult.from_mapping(...) succeeds and reproduces the same developer_attempts_remaining value
render_text continues to print 'unknown' for None and the integer's string form otherwise, unchanged from current behavior for the non-null cases
no other EngineeringResult field, and no other from_mapping/to_dict behavior, changes

a focused test in tests/test_company_engineering_execution.py proves the null-value round-trip specifically (the case the prior review found uncovered), in addition to the existing absent-key and genuine-zero cases
no existing test in the required suites regresses
implementation_summary: Changed EngineeringResult.developer_attempts_remaining from int=0 to int|None=None, updated __post_init__ validation to allow None, updated from_mapping to yield None for both absent and null values (instead of calling int(None) which raised TypeError), and updated render_text to print 'unknown' for None. A new test covers all four cases (absent key, JSON null, explicit 0, positive integer) including the null round-trip that the prior review found uncovered.
objective: The reviewer of work order wo-req-legacy-attempts-remaining-default (finding from-mapping-null-value-crashes, changes_required) found that EngineeringResult.from_mapping (company/engineering/result.py) calls int(data['developer_attempts_remaining']) whenever the key is present, including when its value is JSON null. Once a result whose developer_attempts_remaining field is None is persisted via to_dict(), the key round-trips as null rather than being dropped, so from_mapping raises TypeError on reload. Correct from_mapping so a present-but-null value is treated the same as an absent key (both yield None, rendered as 'unknown'), while a present integer value -- including an explicit 0 -- keeps round-tripping exactly as it already does. This must be the smallest backward-compatible fix; it must not change the shape of the field's representation or add any new compatibility-conversion code.
risks: EngineeringResult.build() passes job.corrections_remaining directly; if that property ever returns None, the field will be None (unknown) rather than an error — this is intentional by the work order but worth verifying downstream consumers of the rendered page handle 'unknown' gracefully
